name: Vietnam
about: Climate varies sharply north-to-south; this is a rough whole-country average. Typhoon risk rises Sep–Nov, especially central/north.
overview: Rice terraces, motorbike-choked cities, and a coastline running the length of the country, from Hanoi to the Mekong Delta.
costOverview: Genuinely one of the cheapest countries to eat and get around in Asia — an overnight Ha Long Bay cruise is the one real splurge most itineraries include.
